user.title: TinyDisplay panel
user.description: Pick a panel and a dashboard. A starter dashboard has been written to your config directory if you had none, so you can accept these and press Submit. The dashboard is validated now, so a mistake in it shows up here rather than as a blank screen.

data_description.driver: Preselected by looking at the USB bus. The HT32 is a 320x170 panel driven over raw USB; the preview renders frames without any hardware attached, which is useful for checking a dashboard.
data_description.dashboard: Only files that parse as a dashboard are listed. Type a path if yours lives somewhere else.
data_description.serial_number: Only needed when more than one identical panel is attached.

error.invalid_dashboard: That dashboard could not be loaded: {error}

abort.already_configured: That panel is already set up.

init.title: Repainting
init.description: The panel repaints when an entity on the dashboard changes. These bounds decide how eagerly.

data_description.min_interval: A floor, so that a burst of state changes becomes one repaint rather than a dozen.
data_description.max_interval: A ceiling, so the panel refreshes even when nothing has changed.
data_description.landscape: Turn off to draw the short way round.
